note: Hand-labelled lot kinds for scoring the title rules. Titles are GCSurplus / Nova Scotia open data (OGL-Canada, OGL-Nova Scotia), loaded Nov 9, 2026. Labels were assigned by the assistant (Grok Bot) from the title text only, before scoring. 'dev' (240 rows: 120 random + 20 each from the generator/laptop/truck/pickup/boat/trailer searches) was labelled first and seen while writing the rules; 'holdout' (200 rows: 140 random + 10 per search, disjoint from dev) was labelled after the rules were written and before they were scored on it. Definitions: bulk = the title says several or mixed items (lot of, assorted, various, a leading count of 2+, scrap); part = a part or accessory is the thing sold, or anything sold for parts/scrap; electronics = computers, electronics and lab/test instruments; equipment = tractors, heavy equipment, mowers, generators; heavy_truck = class 4+ trucks and buses; property = land or buildings.
